senses.gloss: m. = h. נוֹחַ II, kind, gentle, pleasing.
units: Targ. Y. Deut. XVII, 18.—נ׳ ל־ it is good (better) for.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:5:1">Koh. R. to X, 5</cite> [read:] <he>והוה נ׳ ליה דקבריתיה וכ׳</he> it would have been better for him that I should bury him than &c.; (Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᵈ bot. <he>נוֹחַ היה ליה אילו הוה מיית</he>). Koh. R. l. c. <he>נ׳ הוה דייתרים וכ׳</he> it would have been better that his head were taken off than to do this; a. e.
